title: Old-era minute-bar out-of-sample round (2016-01-01 .. 2023-11-09): one look, no tuning

gates.universe: today's NIFTY-100 names with Kite minute bars 2016-01-01..2023-11-09 (survivorship-biased); no point-in-time gate

report_only.sens: same strategy at 5 bps slippage per side (index 2.5 bps; auction family 5 bps vs its 2.1; options haircut x2.5) and whether it would pass there
report_only.min_trades_60_intraday: whether an intraday strategy would pass with 60 trades per half instead of 150
report_only.excess_vs_nifty: net minus side x the trade's notional x the NIFTY 50 (BANKNIFTY futures: NIFTY BANK) move from the entry minute to the exit minute, per half; the relevant line for long-biased strategies (long share of era trades >= 70%)
report_only.listed_weeklies_only: NIFTY weekly option strategies: the same trades restricted to entries on or after 2019-02-11 (first listed NIFTY weekly expiry 2019-02-14); before that the weekly contracts did not exist and the modelled trades are synthetic
report_only.attention: SWING-ATTN-ON-3X also with the 09:16-open exit and with CNC costs (as attention.py reports)

combined_verdict: proven in both eras = FINAL-CONFIRMED on the 2023-26 3-year data AND OOS-CONFIRMED here
luck_rate: share of group-c ids with 2023-26 status FAILED SCREEN that are OOS-CONFIRMED here, against the share of 2023-26 FINAL-CONFIRMED ids (groups a+b) that are OOS-CONFIRMED here; ids 'REJECTED ON FINAL' / 'PASSED SCREEN' / 'not screened on bars3y' are reported separately
cost_model_note: costs.py 2026 rates (COST_MODEL_VERSION) for every year; each runner's own fill model; NIFTY / BANKNIFTY lot sizes as each module pre-registered (2026 lots for index futures 65 / 30; options 75 NIFTY, BANKNIFTY 30) for every date

slippage_bps.options_haircut: max(1 pt, 2 %) per leg per fill, sens x2.5

options_model: options_vrp / options_vrp_vix / options_r3: Black-Scholes MODEL premiums on the NIFTY 50 / NIFTY BANK minute bars with the previous India VIX official close (nse_old) as one flat vol, r 6.5 %, no skew; NOT option prices. NIFTY weekly options were listed only from 2019-02 (BANKNIFTY weeklies from 2016-05), so the weekly strangles' 2016-01..2019-02 trades are on contracts that did not exist. The verdict uses the whole era as modelled; the listed-weeklies block is reported next to it.

data.dirty_rule:
{symbol: sorted dates d} where the overnight link previous-session -> d in the minute data cannot be trusted:
  * the previous NSE regular session is missing from the symbol's minute data (download holes; the lab's
    "previous session" would silently be two sessions back), or the session itself was dropped (< 200 bars):
    d = the first available session after the hole;
  * the Kite overnight ratio (09:15 open / previous 15:29 close) differs from NSE's adjusted ratio (official
    open / previous close, back-adjusted by nse_old's factors incl. demergers) by more than DIRTY_TOL in log
    terms: an unadjusted demerger (ADANIENT 2018-09-06, GRASIM 2017-07-19), a wrong Kite adjustment (NMDC
    2022-10-27) or a bad opening print. Real market moves agree in both sources;
  * NSE has no EQ row for d or for the previous session (no comparison possible) and the Kite overnight move
    exceeds NOCMP_TOL in log terms (ABB 2019-12-20, demerger ex-day mis-adjusted by Kite).
A trade whose entry .. exit dates contain a dirty date of its symbol is excluded (DIRTY RULE, pre-registered);
for index instruments only the first rule applies.
